newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE coffee ends higher, cocoa down, sugar up.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE coffee ends higher, cocoa down, sugar up.

text.p: COFFEE - Nearbys finish at day's highs after fresh rally in NY. Nov/Jan premium at hefty $62. Nov up $9 at $1,512.
COCOA - All positions slide further on arbitrage selling but volume remains modest. March down five stg at 993 stg.
SUGAR - Slightly firmer after NY opens but fails to react to physical news. Dec up 90 cents at $323.50 by 1605 GMT.
